children: Planet Labs PBC reported results for the three months ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $116.1M, a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(9.4)M and basic and diluted net loss per share of $(0.03), marking revenue growth and an improvement in profitability versus the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue: $116.1M for the three months ended July 31, 2026, up from $73.4M in the year‑ago quarter (58% YoY).
Net income: Net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(9.4)M for the three months ended July 31, 2026, improved from a $(22.6)M loss in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted EPS: Basic and diluted net loss per share of $(0.03) for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus $(0.07) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue growth of roughly 51–58% year over year (quarter and year‑to‑date) was driven largely by defense and intelligence contract expansions and satellite hardware deliveries.
Shift toward subscription and usage‑based data licensing and increased platform self‑service (Planet Insights) is growing recurring revenue.
Expanded government and commercial adoption across defense, agriculture, mapping, energy and insurance verticals with strong net dollar retention of about 109%.
Operational scaling: fleet growth to over 100 satellites, increased satellite manufacturing and ground station activity, and continued investment in next‑generation sensors and analytics.
Strategy moving downstream into integrated, AI‑enabled analytics and partner ecosystems to expand addressable market and drive customer expansion.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
